notes: Only n_o was assigned. All other fields/sides are unassigned placeholders. Target identified from Study 2, heart-attack outcome, and the average-student comparison condition, independently of row order or numeric matching. Rendered printed pp. 506–507 (PDF pages 5–6); Table 2 Average student header carries superscript b, whose Group A count is 25. This is the within-condition self-other comparison, not the omnibus F across three comparison targets. Table 2 also gives Group A condition counts 27 (one of your friends) and 31 (closest friend); these are different comparison conditions and are not summed for this target. Method’s Group A total 83 is not substituted for the target condition n. No N derived from degrees of freedom. Unassigned effect-size and p fields were not completed.
